name: Related Notes
description: Find text matches and related notes for selected text, then link the selection to a chosen note.
command.link: Link selected text to candidate note
permission.editor.read: Read selected text and the current note path.
permission.editor.write: Replace selected text with a link in the current note when requested.
permission.notes.list: Find literal and RAG related Markdown notes in an authorized workspace folder.
permission.notes.read: Read authorized note excerpts for literal and RAG search; RAG may use NoteGen's configured AI providers.
permission.notes.open: Open a candidate note when requested.
setting.textResultCount.desc: Maximum number of notes that directly contain the selected text.
setting.ragEnabled.desc: After showing text matches, search indexed notes for related content.
setting.ragMinScore.desc: Filter the 0–1 scores returned by related search. Higher values reduce weak matches but may miss useful notes; this does not change NoteGen's global RAG settings.
setting.ragResultCount.desc: Maximum number of related notes that meet the minimum relevance score.
